scope: Bounded native stages of the actual NX Studio RGB16 renderer; not complete source-image parity.

runtime.path: NX Studio1.10.1 Windows image_render.n5m; Wine is a research oracle only.

rgb_lab_dispatch.selection: image_render0x48bf50 creates a CML XForm before0x48b010 chooses its processing mode. An accepted RGB/Lab A2B0 with Lab destination selects mode2, clears CML transformer state+0x600 and installs internal LUTRGBLab at+0x730.
rgb_lab_dispatch.abi: Filter vtable0xb2a478 setup slot+0x330->0x4e6d10; process slot+0x338->0x4e6ee0. Process returns a pointer-shaped error, null on success, and takes self,format,width,height,input,input-row/input-pixel/input-channel strides,output,output-row/output-pixel/output-channel strides.
rgb_lab_dispatch.consumer: Parser0x4e5290->0x4e5700->0x4e5860 consumes mft2 directly. Observed format0x10060201, pixel stride6, channel stride2; row0x4f2690->0x528460.
rgb_lab_dispatch.limit: Other selector modes can combine internal LUT, matrix and CML stages. Previous CML profile-consumer equivalence does not establish equivalence for this path.

native_rgb_lab.interface: normalized_grid(profile), transform(pixels,grid,width), convert(profile,pixels,width); pixels are packed(height*width,3) little-endian uint16.
native_rgb_lab.profile_scope: v2.2 D50 scanner RGB/Lab ICC, A2B0mft2,grid65,identity matrix,4096input/3output curve entries. Each curve must differ by at most2 from floor(i*65535/(count-1)); unsupported profiles fail closed.
native_rgb_lab.normalization: CLUT L becomes(min(L,65280)*65535+32640)//65280; a/b remain unchanged. The six near-identity curves are bypassed.
native_rgb_lab.arithmetic: float32 scale64*float32(16384/65535), nearest-even Q14 coordinates, tetrahedral weights. Each row's groups of4 floor the weighted sum/16384; remaining1..3pixels add8192 before shifting14. Row boundaries must be preserved.
native_rgb_lab.verification: Builder and root independently replayed saved captures; all recorded artifact hashes checked.95focused tests pass, including74new renderer tests; scoped Ruff/format and diff checks pass.
native_rgb_lab.limit: Saved captures originate from experimental instrumentation. Standalone fresh kernel validation is separate. Profile generation, source WB/matrix/transfer order, later Lab/Lch transforms and full-image determinism remain unresolved.
